Open Android Doc Scanner 0.7.0
Upstream: https://github.com/phillip9933/open-android-doc-scanner
Release: https://github.com/phillip9933/open-android-doc-scanner/releases/tag/v0.7.0

Current integration (0.61.4): scanner-ui-compose and scanner-processing-opencv are built from local source through dapan.gradle.kts. Other SDK modules resolve from vendor/sdk-0.7.0/maven. Upstream licenses and notices are retained.
The document detector model is downloaded as verified data within the app; scanner code and native runtimes are bundled in the app. There is no separately installed scanner component APK in this release.
Original source model and dictionary source are retained for reproducibility. Upstream machine-specific build evidence, cached builds and duplicate SDK ZIPs are excluded from this delivery.
The earlier integration description is preserved in docs/history/references/SCANNER-INTEGRATION-original.txt.
